'''Magic Hair Gel''' is a [[Trinkets|trinket]] item obtainable after claiming [[Mastery Cave#Masteries|Combat Mastery]]. It can be purchased from [[Alex]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|100|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. It is the only trinket that cannot be dropped from [[Monsters|enemies]], [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]], or [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|Skull Cavern treasure chests]].<ref name="noMonsterDrop"/>

While the Magic Hair Gel is equipped in the trinket slot, the player's hair color constantly cycles through the colors of a [[Prismatic Shard]]. This "prismatic dye" effect is the same as the one seen on the [[Magic Cowboy Hat]] or [[Magic Turban]].

The Magic Hair Gel cannot be re-forged on an [[Anvil]].
